provenance.method: Need-led Organisations & peer community UK v1 question; routes to inspectable resources without provider ranking, safety certification or personalised recommendation.

question: How can I check how private an online neurodivergent group or forum really is before I post?
why_it_matters: People may disclose diagnosis, health, work or family information without realising who can read, index, copy or retain it.
current_understanding: Check whether reading requires an account, whether posts are public or members-only, what identity information is required, which third-party platform hosts the group, and the current privacy and deletion terms. 'Private group' does not mean confidential: other participants can still copy or share material. Do not post information you cannot tolerate becoming more widely visible.
evidence_needed: Comparable privacy metadata for major neurodivergent community platforms.
Evidence on privacy harms and disclosure expectations in disability peer communities.
reopening_conditions: A reviewed community changes platform or privacy terms.
A reliable privacy audit becomes available.
dissent: Some people value pseudonymous public forums because they are searchable and low-friction; privacy and accessibility can pull in different directions.
